operating_point.seeds_and_draws: each plant places its defect from DETECTION_SEED (run i: seed i): a place among the study's folders, a name, a byte and a bit, a group, a JSON writing, a hash; 200 runs a plant, each a fresh process

gate_1_study_controls.claim: a study packed and pulled back is the folder it was, file for file, and each planted defect makes the round trip refuse: a stray file, a hidden file or folder, a changed group file, changed figure data, a base input hash the study or its spec does not record, a machine path, a container rewritten by hand with its manifest made to agree (a changed group file, a changed input hash, a reference in no saved folder), and a study container named as a bundle
gate_1_study_controls.case: tests/sharing/test_study_container.py::test_a_clean_study_round_trips (mime.saved.pack, then mime.saved.pull of the container into a new folder, then StudyResult.read), with MIME_P2_PLANT naming the plant

prediction.unit: planted runs caught, of 200, for each of the 10 plants; 0 of 200 clean runs flagged
prediction.why: every carried byte is held to a sha256 in the manifest, every group file to one in study.json and every figure's data to one in its recipe, and the layout is closed both at pack and at unpack: a defect of one bit or one name changes a hash or a name the checks compare exactly, wherever the seed puts it

gate_1_study_controls.metric: the round trip's exit (a refusal fails the test); the in-suite test names the code each plant is refused with

control.plant: stray | env | group | figure | input-hash | machine-path | forged-group | forged-input-hash | reference-outside | renamed (tests/sharing/study_plants.py)
control.environment_variable: MIME_P2_PLANT (the plant's name); DETECTION_SEED places it
control.resolution: one flipped bit of a group file (sha256), one stray name (a closed layout), one byte of a JSON file's writing (sha256 in the figure's recipe): the smallest defect each check sees, planted at that size

gate_1_study_controls.if_wrong: a missed plant is a place or a form a check does not reach: name it, close it, and plant it again; a clean failure is a round trip that does not reproduce a study folder, a defect of pack or unpack
gate_1_study_controls.cannot_discriminate_if: the plant left the folder unchanged (a stray written over an existing name, a reindented JSON file whose bytes came out equal): the in-suite test's seeds and the rates say whether that happened; a plant whose catch comes from an exception rather than a refusal would pass the rate and fail the in-suite code check

bits.cases: a probe packs the full toy, the terms demo (an MIT layer, a layer a declared permission lets travel, a layer that may not be redistributed and travels as a reference) and the toy saved with fewer reference steps, each saved once by this branch's head, with lanep/p6-manifests (the base) and with this branch's head, in one job; then this head unpacks each bundle the base packed
bits.prediction: every bundle byte-equal between base and head (sha256), and every base bundle unpacked by the head to a folder that reads; no simulation output is produced or compared by P2

controls.repeat: the head packs each folder twice: equal bytes, so a difference between base and head is the code's
controls.one_ulp: the probe compares the full toy's bundle with the bundle of the toy saved with fewer reference steps (one input changed): they must differ, so the comparison can fail

costs.prediction: no time or memory claim is made
